llm_response.Content: LRU (Least Recently Used) eviction is triggered by the system's need to remove a cache entry that is no longer in use. Hybrid combines this behavior with expiration by integrating LRU eviction with a mechanism that accounts for cache expiration, such as a time-based expiration policy.
